Name: Haruka Yamamoto

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Economics Research Intern, Mitsubishi UFJ Research and Consulting. Assisted senior economists in analyzing the impact of fiscal policy changes on regional economic growth using econometric models. Collected, cleaned, and organized large datasets from government and financial sources for use in economic forecasts. Prepared visualizations and summary reports to communicate research findings to non-technical stakeholders. Collaborated with a team to conduct literature reviews and synthesize recent academic developments relevant to Japan's macroeconomic trends. Presented preliminary research outcomes in weekly meetings and received feedback for further refinement.

Education:
- 2021--2023: M.A. in Economics, University of Tokyo. Main courses: Advanced Econometrics, Macroeconomic Theory, Development Economics, International Finance, Japane
